limitations: FP8 is lossy. Ordinary learned verification is not admitted as serial-greedy numerical equivalence.
Each final profile is one short full replay, not a sustained, network or multi-node SLO.

RxR uses its own checkpoint and an experimental 30-degree prompt. The pinned official eval_rxr.sh actually uses the default R2R prompt/15-degree turns; corrected replay is queued separately. This historical profile is not the official launcher configuration.
Both BF16 and FP8 baselines use the same learned draft trained with the R2R BF16 target; no RxR- or FP8-specific draft retraining.
SR/SPL comes from separate closed-loop evaluation; token agreement does not certify task accuracy.
B4 RxR previously failed on a noncontiguous draft mask after KV growth, not OOM. Fix a99bd03 is used here; B2 retains long-history/simulator memory headroom.
